# Baseline results (v1.0)

**Simulated, benchmark-parameterized. Not plant data.** Every number below is a RESULT from `reports/results_baseline.json` (generated by `notebooks/05_baseline_report.ipynb`): config hash `2f9b035c9964`, seed 20261116, 30 replications, all completed: yes. Intervals: t-based 95% over replications (T4.1.3).

## Line
| Metric | Result |
|---|---|
| Line OEE (filler-referenced, D4) | 57.3% (95% CI 56.4 to 58.2) |
| Availability / Performance / Quality | 71.3% / 80.7% / 99.74% |
| Good vials per scheduled-production hour (primary) | 8,252 (95% CI 8,127 to 8,378) |
| Good vials per calendar hour | 3,805 (95% CI 3,530 to 4,080) |
| Campaign makespan, h | 161.7 (95% CI 152.9 to 170.4) |
| Mean batch cycle time (start to last vial packed), h | 31.9 (95% CI 30.0 to 33.7) |
| Mean batch lead time incl. QA release, h | 89.2 (95% CI 78.6 to 99.8) |
| Mean WIP, vials | 16,436 (95% CI 15,808 to 17,063) |

## Station OEE
| Station | A | P | Q | OEE (95% CI) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| washer | 90.6% | 43.5% | 100.00% | 39.4% (38.8 to 40.0) |
| tunnel | 91.5% | 43.1% | 100.00% | 39.4% (38.8 to 40.0) |
| filler | 71.3% | 80.7% | 99.90% | 57.4% (56.5 to 58.3) |
| capper | 84.6% | 54.3% | 100.00% | 45.9% (45.2 to 46.6) |
| avi | 79.8% | 57.6% | 98.83% | 45.4% (44.7 to 46.1) |
| labeler | 78.7% | 58.3% | 100.00% | 45.8% (45.1 to 46.5) |
| cartoner | 71.7% | 68.6% | 100.00% | 49.1% (48.4 to 49.9) |

Station P includes starvation and blocking (D3), so a fast station that waits on a slower one shows low P without being at fault. Station Q is below 100% only where vials leave the flow: fill-weight rejects at the filler and AVI rejects (sent to manual re-inspection, where most return to the flow). The offline manual-inspection pool is left out (its OEE is not meaningful; see `docs/metrics_schema.md`).

## Loss Pareto at the filler (share of scheduled production time)
| Loss | Six big losses | Factor | Share (95% CI) |
|---|---|---|---|
| CHANGEOVER | Setup and adjustment | Availability | 27.37% (95% CI 26.34 to 28.40) |
| BLOCKED | Idling and minor stoppages (blocked, D3) | Performance | 10.01% (95% CI 9.19 to 10.82) |
| MINOR_STOP | Idling and minor stoppages | Performance | 1.97% (95% CI 1.83 to 2.10) |
| STARVED | Idling and minor stoppages (starved, D3) | Performance | 1.85% (95% CI 1.32 to 2.37) |
| DOWN | Equipment failure | Availability | 1.13% (95% CI 0.49 to 1.77) |
| WAIT_STAFF | Setup and adjustment (staff resource, D2) | Availability | 0.22% (95% CI -0.10 to 0.54) |
| avi_confirmed | Process defects | Quality | 0.09% (95% CI 0.09 to 0.09) |
| fill_weight | Process defects | Quality | 0.06% (95% CI 0.06 to 0.06) |

Waiting for staff is zero in most replications, so its t-interval can dip below 0; read it as "under 1% of scheduled time".

## Preliminary bottleneck evidence
Evidence only; the constraint is identified in T5.2.3 with several methods.

| Station | Rate, vials/min | Utilization | Starved | Blocked | Queue in front, sub-lots |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| washer | 350 | 39.4% | 1.6% | 48.3% | 18.7 |
| tunnel | 350 | 39.4% | 3.3% | 48.8% | 16.8 |
| filler | 240 | 57.5% | 1.8% | 10.0% | 18.7 |
| capper | 300 | 45.9% | 26.9% | 10.2% | 2.9 |
| avi | 300 | 45.9% | 25.0% | 7.3% | 4.3 |
| labeler | 300 | 45.8% | 25.8% | 5.5% | 4.0 |
| cartoner | 280 | 49.1% | 21.0% | 0.0% | 4.4 |

Reading notes: starved and blocked are shares of scheduled production time. Buffers hold at most 20 sub-lots. The queue in front of the washer is vials waiting to be released into the line and sits near its cap by construction, so it is not constraint evidence.
